## YOUR VOICE
##### Proudly endorsed by:
##### A leader our schools deserve.
##### ​
"As a single mother with a son in public school, I have learned what leadership truly means by working alongside caregivers, teachers, and our community. I pledge to be a responsive leader who always puts the needs of students, parents, and teachers first."
MEET VIRGINIA
SEE MORE ENDORSEMENTS
### SUPPORT
### VIRGINIA CHEUNG
### FOR SCHOOL BOARD
Make your voice heard! Donate today to support Virginia!
​
A child's future should not depend on luck.
We need Virginia's leadership to ensure our tax dollars reach the classrooms and schools where our children need it most!
HELP HER WIN!
#### Every student should be safe, seen, valued & heard.
Our children deserve a world-class public education system that does not sacrifice either equity or excellence. Our job as community leaders is to ensure every school has the supports and resources necessary to provide a quality public education for all.
GET INVOLVED TODAY! VOLUNTEER WITH THE CAMPAIGN.
